EU antitrust probe launched into Coca-Cola bottler

The European Union's antitrust regulator has initiated a probe into Coca-Cola Europacific Partners, alleging the company may have abused its dominant market position in its dealings with supermarkets and other retail outlets across Europe. The investigation will examine the bottler's practices.
